patch.value:
## Review and native execution findings
PR 1279 second review identified Bash UTF-16 surrogate splitting and unquoted Zsh static metadata. Native Fish execution then confirmed equivalent static choice injection, unquoted runtime flags, incomplete fallback backslash quoting, and obsolete caret stderr redirection.

## Implementation
Bash escapes Unicode code points. Zsh protects both single-quoted source and the later _arguments parenthesized-action evaluation, including runtime flag specifications. Fish separately protects source quoting and completion-time choice expansion, quotes runtime field flags, preserves literal resolver fallbacks, and uses supported 2>/dev/null redirection.

## Verification
Real Bash regression covers six input routes and retains astral Unicode. Zsh source/evaluation regressions fail before quoting and pass afterward. A required native smoke command runs 31 Fish/Zsh parser cases, including type/tag values, runtime flags, helper output and unavailable-helper fallbacks. Missing native interpreters fail rather than skip; required CI smoke setup installs both shells. Existing completion rendering contracts remain enforced with quoted Fish runtime flags.

## Lineage
This is a child of the first review boundary fix and links to the completion decomposition owner. Historical parent fixes remain closed; only this actively edited issue is in progress.
